          pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".auth /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
          pass=`echo ${pass:1:-1} | base64 -d`
          podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:8} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false

          # Used for 4.15 and older releases.
          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          set -x

          export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

          # run latest release on upstream main branch
          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Running on upstream main branch"
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git
          else
            git clone --single-branch --branch OPERATOR_VERSION https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator.git
          fi
          cd ptp-operator
          # OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build
          else
            # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
            if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
            else
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
            fi
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"
          fi
          podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "false" ]]; then
            # If we a running a downstream run we are done
            exit 0
          fi

          # If were running upstream we should also use the upstream daemon!
          echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/linuxptp-daemon.git
          cd linuxptp-daemon
          # Split DAEMON_IMG into IMAGE_TAG_BASE and VERSION because

          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image
          podman push ${DAEMON_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          echo "Running on main branch of cloud-event-proxy"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/redhat-cne/cloud-event-proxy.git
          cd cloud-event-proxy
          IMG=${SIDECAR_IMG} make podman-build
          podman push ${SIDECAR_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

      securityContext:
        privileged: true
      volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push
          name: dockercfg
          readOnly: true
        - name: secret-volume

        items:
        - key: .dockerconfigjson
          path: config.json

    - name: dockercfg
      secret:
        secretName: BUILDER_DOCKERCFG
        defaultMode: 384

issues.ai_summary:
---

## Cross-Suite Summary — `periodic-ci-openshift-release-main-nightly-4.22-e2e-telco5g-ptp`

---

**TL;DR:** linuxptp-daemon PR #618 broke T-GM holdover and T-BC sync (9 failures); a test-code key regression in `d20ffcb` broke all 5 parallel event tests (5 failures).

---

### Root Cause Groups

| # | Failures | Suites | Root Cause |
|---|----------|--------|------------|
| 1 | **9 / 15** | tbc (×6), tgm (×3) | `openshift/linuxptp-daemon` **PR #618** (`d2ff2d154d`, merged `release-4.22` 2026-06-30): T-GM holdover state machine bypassed — class 7 never emitted, jumps LOCKED (6) → FREERUN (248) directly; T-BC on `cnfdf32` consequently stuck in FREERUN (class 248) with phc2sys never starting, cascading to all 6 tbc serial tests. |
| 2 | **5 / 15** | bc, dualfollower, dualnicbc, dualnicbcha, oc (all `-parallel`) | Test-code regression **commit `d20ffcb`** (Jul 3, 2026, `main`): `createStoredEvent` in `test/pkg/event/event.go` changed the values-map key from `DataType` (`"notification"`) to `ResourceAddress`; `testSyncState()` still looks up `values["notification"]`, always gets nil, `wasLocked` never becomes `true`. All 5 parallel suites ran concurrently, all timed out at ≈363 s (`ptp.go:393`). Secondary contributor: `cloud-event-proxy:release-4.22` sidecar and/or the shared `consumer` pod in `ptp-event-framework-test` may not have been serving `OsClockSyncStateChange` events during the parallel window (`PushInitialEvent` exhausted all 30 × 10 s retries). |
| 3 | **1 / 15** | dualnicbcha (serial) | phc2sys HA failover — phc2sys did not switch to secondary ptp4l after the primary interface was downed, or failed to emit the expected log line. Likely a cascade of the T-BC FREERUN state from Group 1. |

---

### Cross-Suite Patterns

- **tbc + tgm share one root cause** (PR #618): T-GM FREERUN propagates upstream — T-BC has no grandmaster to lock to, leaving cnfdf32 in class 248 and making all T-BC serial tests deterministically fail. Fixing PR #618 unblocks both suites.
- **All 5 parallel suites share one root cause** (commit `d20ffcb`): bc, dualfollower, dualnicbc, dualnicbcha, and oc fail with identical timing (≈363 s) and identical failure message, confirming a single shared code path broken by the same commit.
- **dualnicbcha is the only suite with failures from two separate groups** (1 parallel event + 1 serial HA), making it appear to have the most diverse failure set.
- **No suite-specific flakes** — every failure traces to one of the two breaking changes above.

---

### Actionable Recommendations

1. **Revert or patch `openshift/linuxptp-daemon` PR #618 on `release-4.22`** — restore the T-GM holdover servo-state path so ts2phc emits clock class 7 before transitioning to 248, and re-add the FREERUN `ptp-state-change` CloudEvent dispatch in the restarted-ts2phc code path. This is the highest-leverage fix: **9/15 failures resolved**.

2. **Fix the `createStoredEvent` key regression from commit `d20ffcb`** in `test/pkg/event/event.go` (runs from `main`) — update the consumer in `ptp.go:413–414` to use the new `ResourceAddress`-keyed lookup (e.g., `values[resourceAddress].(string)`) instead of `values["notification"]`, or revert the key to `DataType`. Also pin `CONSUMER_IMG` to a versioned tag instead of `:latest` to prevent silent consumer regressions. **5/15 failures resolved**.

3. **Add a guard in tbc test AfterEach** to restore the original `ptpConfig` even on failure — this prevents the cascade from Group 1 (nil `ptpConfig`) from adding spurious secondary failures when the primary T-BC issue recurs.

---

**Overall Issue Class:** `test_failure` (production image regression in `release-4.22` + test-code regression on `main`)

**Overall Severity:** **CRITICAL** — 15/15 failures, every suite affected, PTP synchronization infrastructure completely non-functional for both T-GM and T-BC hardware paths.


---

# Per-Suite Details


## bc

---

### Suite: bc (1 failures)

**Suite TL;DR:** The single `[bc-parallel] Event based tests PTP Slave Clock Sync` failure is caused by a test code regression in `main` that changed the event-value map key from `DataType` to `ResourceAddress`, making the state lookup for `"notification"` permanently return nil so the clock is never seen as LOCKED.

**Root Cause Groups:**

- **Group 1: createStoredEvent key change breaks state lookup in testSyncState** (affects: `[It] [bc-parallel] Event based tests PTP Slave Clock Sync`)

  - **Evidence:**

    Failure message from artifact XML at `ptp.go:393` at `07/21/26 11:03:31.053`:
    ```
    <failure message="OS Clock was never LOCKED and test timed out" type="failed">
    [FAILED] OS Clock was never LOCKED and test timed out
    In [It] at: .../test/conformance/parallel/ptp.go:393 @ 07/21/26 11:03:31.053
    ```

    The PushInitialEvents goroutine DID find and parse a LOCKED event (at `event.go:730`, 10:58:36):
    ```
    [Jul 21 10:58:36.093][event.go: 730] Context Attributes,
      type: event.sync.sync-status.os-clock-sync-state-change
    Data, {"values":[{"ResourceAddress":"/cluster/node/cnfdf32.telco5gran.eng.rdu2.redhat.com/CLOCK_REALTIME",
      "data_type":"notification","value":"LOCKED"},
      {"ResourceAddress":"/cluster/node/cnfdf32.../CLOCK_REALTIME","data_type":"metric","value":"-..."}]}
    ```

    Git diff from commit `d20ffcb` (Jul 3, 2026) in `test/pkg/event/event.go`:
    ```diff
    -  dataType := string(v.DataType)
    -  values[dataType] = v.Value
    +  // Use ResourceAddress as key to avoid collisions…
    ```

## Cross-Suite Summary — `periodic-ci-openshift-release-main-nightly-5.0-e2e-telco5g-ptp`

**TL;DR:** Hardware sync failures across RDU2 nodes and a deterministic PMC split-args code bug together account for 36 test failures spanning all 7 suites.

---

### Root Cause Groups

| # | Description | Count | Suites |
|---|-------------|-------|--------|
| 1 | **T-GM ts2phc stuck in FREERUN on cnfdf32** — DPLL shows LOCKED but ts2phc reports FREERUN; daemon gate blocks phc2sys, clockClass never reaches 6, cascading to event/metric/holdover failures | **11 / 36** | tgm |
| 2 | **BC slave port `ens2f0np0` / hardware clock sync degradation** — BC slave stuck in MASTER state; ptp4l clockClass stuck at 248 (FREERUN) on dualnicbc nodes; cascading to config, event-consumer, and interface-recovery tests | **~14 / 36** | dualnicbc (5–6), dualnicbcha (8–9) |
| 3 | **PMC split-args bug in `getClockIDViaPMC`** — commits `3b93c9f408` / `d20ffcbf0c` pass `"GET"`, `"PARENT_DATA_SET"` as two separate argv elements; pmc rejects both with `bad command`; all `ClockSync` tests time out deterministically | **~5 / 36** | dualnicbc (3), dualnicbcha (2) |
| 4 | **Parallel event soak test timeout (OCPBUGS-60570 interaction)** — `PushInitialEvent` retry loop (up to 30 × 10 s = 300 s) shares the same 6-minute soak timer; release-5.0 image fix (OCPBUGS-60570) slows initial event delivery, exhausting the budget before LOCKED is received; all 5 parallel suites hit this simultaneously pointing to a cluster-wide event delivery slowdown | **5 / 36** | bc (1), dualfollower (1), oc (1), dualnicbc (1), dualnicbcha (1) |
| 5 | **No T-BC topology on cluster** — `CreatePtpConfigurationsWithRetry` finds 0 T-BC L2 solutions on cnfdf30–32; `execute.BeforeAll` calls `Fail()` instead of `Skip()`, failing the first spec and silently skipping the rest | **1 / 36** | tbc |

---

### Cross-Suite Patterns

- **Hardware sync failure is the dominant cross-suite thread.** Root causes 1 and 2 both point to the RDU2 test nodes (cnfdf30–32) failing to maintain a healthy PTP grandmaster-to-slave chain during this job window. tgm (ts2phc FREERUN on the GM node) and dualnicbc/dualnicbcha (clockClass/port-state failures on BC nodes) are facets of the same degraded physical sync fabric.

- **The PMC split-args bug (root cause 3) is strictly test-code and suite-independent.** It affects every suite that exercises the `getClockIDViaPMC` fallback path — currently triggered only in dualnicbc and dualnicbcha because their log format misses the primary log-parsing path. bc-serial escapes because it locates the clock ID via log parsing before reaching the broken fallback.

- **The parallel soak timeout (root cause 4) is cross-suite by construction.** All five parallel sub-suites (`bc-parallel`, `dualfollower-parallel`, `dualnicbc-parallel`, `dualnicbcha-parallel`, `oc-parallel`) run the same `testSyncState` test against the same cluster-event infrastructure. Their simultaneous failure at ≈363 seconds is a single shared event, not five independent regressions.

- **Suite-specific failures:** tbc's BeforeAll topology failure is isolated to that suite; tgm's ts2phc FREERUN affects only the GM node tests.

---

### Actionable Recommendations

1. **Fix the PMC split-args bug immediately (highest leverage, deterministic, trivially patched).**
   In `test/pkg/ptphelper/ptphelper.go` (around line 144), change:
   ```go
   // current (broken):
   []string{"pmc", "-b", "0", "-u", "-f", configFile, "GET", "PARENT_DATA_SET"}
   // fix:
   []string{"pmc", "-b", "0", "-u", "-f", configFile, "GET PARENT_DATA_SET"}
   ```
   This matches the existing pattern in `ptptesthelper.go:588` (`GetClockClassViaPMC`) and will immediately unblock ~5 deterministically failing tests in dualnicbc and dualnicbcha.

2. **Investigate and remediate the RDU2 hardware sync chain (cnfdf30–32).**
   Both the ts2phc FREERUN (tgm) and the BC slave MASTER-state / clockClass-248 failures (dualnicbc, dualnicbcha) trace to the physical PTP grandmaster-to-slave path being degraded during this run window. Check GNSS/GPS signal quality on the GM node, verify the T-GM NIC (ens7fx/WPC card) cable and SFP state, and confirm DPLL lock propagation from GM to BC nodes before re-running.

3. **Decouple `PushInitialEvent` retries from the soak timer, and add a `Skip` path for missing topologies.**
   For root cause 4: run the `PushInitialEvent` retry loop before starting `tcEndChan`, or extend the parallel soak window to accommodate the OCPBUGS-60570 slow-start behavior.
   For root cause 5 (tbc): replace the `Fail("Could not create a ptp config…")` call in `execute.BeforeAll` with a `Skip(...)` when no topology is found, preventing misleading failures when the cluster lacks T-BC hardware.

`infra_other` + `test_regression` (mixed: ~21 failures are hardware/infra-driven; ~5 are a deterministic test code bug; 5 are a test/infra interaction flake; 1 is a topology mismatch)

**HIGH** — 36 failures spanning all 7 suites; two root causes are entirely blocking for their affected suites (ts2phc FREERUN, BC slave MASTER state), and one is a trivially fixable deterministic code regression that has been silently breaking ClockSync tests across at least two suites.

**Root Cause Groups:**

- **Group 1: PMC split-args bug in `getClockIDViaPMC`** (affects: *Slave can sync to master*, *Downstream slave can sync to BC master*, *Can provide a profile with higher priority*)

  - **Evidence:**
    ```
    parentPortIdentity.clockIdentity not found in pmc output for /var/run/ptp4l.1.config: bad command: GET
    bad command: PARENT_DATA_SET
    grandmasterIdentity not found in pmc output for /var/run/ptp4l.1.config: bad command: GET
    bad command: PARENT_DATA_SET
    Timed out after 203.731s.  / 203.074s. / 201.562s.
    ```

  - **Root Cause:** `getClockIDViaPMC` in `test/pkg/ptphelper/ptphelper.go` (introduced in commit `d20ffcbf0c`, merged via `855c9e1493 2026-07-07`) passes the pmc batch command as **two separate** slice elements — `"GET"` and `"PARENT_DATA_SET"` — rather than the single combined string `"GET PARENT_DATA_SET"`:
    ```go

    []string{"pmc", "-b", "0", "-u", "-f", configFile, "GET", "PARENT_DATA_SET"}
    // CORRECT (ptptesthelper.go:588, same repo):

    ```

Receiving `"GET"` alone produces `bad command: GET`; `"PARENT_DATA_SET"` alone produces `bad command: PARENT_DATA_SET`. **Root Cause Groups:**

- **Group 1: PMC split-args bug in `getClockIDViaPMC`** (affects: *Slave can sync to master*, *Downstream slave can sync to BC master*, *Can provide a profile with higher priority*)

  - **Evidence:**
    ```
    parentPortIdentity.clockIdentity not found in pmc output for /var/run/ptp4l.1.config: bad command: GET
    bad command: PARENT_DATA_SET
    grandmasterIdentity not found in pmc output for /var/run/ptp4l.1.config: bad command: GET
    bad command: PARENT_DATA_SET
    Timed out after 203.731s.  / 203.074s. / 201.562s.
    ```

  - **Root Cause:** `getClockIDViaPMC` in `test/pkg/ptphelper/ptphelper.go` (introduced in commit `d20ffcbf0c`, merged via `855c9e1493 2026-07-07`) passes the pmc batch command as **two separate** slice elements — `"GET"` and `"PARENT_DATA_SET"` — rather than the single combined string `"GET PARENT_DATA_SET"`:
    ```go
    // BUGGY (ptphelper.go:144):
    []string{"pmc", "-b", "0", "-u", "-f", configFile, "GET", "PARENT_DATA_SET"}
    // CORRECT (ptptesthelper.go:588, same repo):

    ```
